The old `update_work()` function was also deleted, breaking existing callers. The file parses only because the code is hidden inside strings. Required interface names do not exist at module scope. Fix: remove the `sectionN = '''`/`'''` wrappers so the classes/functions are real module-level code, keep `update_work` (or a compatible alias) for existing callers, and rerun the repository's update_work tests.
